title: Maintenance Tech Jobs Projected to Grow 14% #shorts
desc:
Maintenance techs are in demand. Jobs for industrial machinery mechanics, maintenance workers and millwrights are projected to grow 14% from 2025 to 2035, with about 51,900 openings a year. Median pay was $64,100 in May 2025.

Get new techs productive faster by training them on the logic they will really see. RungWise PLC Academy from Syon Automation LLC teaches ladder logic rung by rung, with a quiz after every module. Free 14-day trial: https://syonautomation.com/rungwise.html

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh).

title: OPC UA Explained in 30 Seconds #shorts
desc:
OPC UA in 30 seconds.

OPC UA was released in 2008. It is a platform-independent standard for machines and software to share data, from embedded controllers to the cloud, with security built in: encrypted sessions, signed messages and X.509 certificates.

DatumLab from Syon Automation LLC connects to any OPC UA server (Kepware, FactoryTalk Linx Gateway, Ignition, Siemens S7-1500, Beckhoff) for live trends, loop performance, FFT and SPC. Free 14-day trial: https://syonautomation.com/datumlab.html

Source: OPC Foundation (opcfoundation.org).

#OPCUA #IIoT #PLC #SCADA #DataAnalysis #IndustrialAutomation

title: Software Idea: Scan the Bin, Find the Spare Part #shorts
desc:
The line is down. The fix is quick. But first, someone has to find the spare part.

An idea for our next app:
• A QR code on every parts bin. Scan it to see what's inside, how many are left and which machines use it
• Scan a machine to see every critical spare it needs, and exactly where each one is
• Take one out and the count drops. Hit the minimum and purchasing gets a reorder alert

Would your plant use it? Tell us in the comments. The best ideas become the next Syon Automation LLC app.

#Maintenance #SpareParts #MRO #Downtime #Manufacturing #SoftwareIdeas
